earnings.title: Chief Financial Officer
highlights: Delivered Comparable Hotel RevPAR Growth of 8.8% and Comparable Hotel Total RevPAR Growth of 7.3%
Comparable hotel RevPAR increased 8.8%, supported by rate growth and broad-based strength in leisure transient, group, and business transient demand.
Comparable hotel Total RevPAR grew 7.3%, reflecting higher food and beverage revenues and leisure transient demand.
outlook: Raising Full Year 2026 Growth Guidance for Comparable Hotel RevPAR to 6.75% and Total RevPAR to 6.0%

We now expect full year comparable hotel RevPAR growth of approximately 6.75% and comparable hotel Total RevPAR growth of approximately 6.0% over 2025, both of which are above the high end of our previously announced guidance ranges.
